stage_2_story.text_en:
Avi had been planning to renovate the small study room for months. One long weekend, he finally decided to do it himself. He laid out all his tools on the floor: a hammer, a drill, a tape measure, a level, sandpaper, plaster, a paintbrush, screws, nails, and a ladder.

He started by measuring the wall with the tape measure. He wanted to put up two long wooden shelves. After marking the spots with a pencil, he pressed the level against the wall to make sure the marks were perfectly horizontal. Then he picked up the drill and made four clean holes at the marked positions.

Before inserting the wall plugs and screws, Avi noticed a long crack running across the lower part of the wall. He mixed a small amount of plaster, pressed it firmly into the crack with a spatula, and smoothed it flat. He let it dry for an hour.

Once the plaster was dry, he rubbed it down with sandpaper until the surface was smooth and even. Then he painted the entire wall with two coats of soft white paint using a wide paintbrush. For the top of the wall near the ceiling, he climbed the ladder carefully.

After the paint dried, he attached the shelf brackets using screws and a screwdriver. He placed the wooden boards on the brackets and tapped a nail at each end to hold them in place. He checked everything one more time with the level. The shelves were straight and solid. Avi stepped back, looked at the room, and felt very proud of his work.
